levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عدي بن خيار

notes: Uthman speaks in the saying («فتشهد ثم قال») and is named in the story, so he is the last link, as in the «عثمان speaks» case of rule 6
«تابعه إسحاق الكلبي حدثني الزهري مثله» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«وقال بشر بن شعيب» opens a second isnad with the same saying: its own group; «أبي» is Shuʿayb (a relation)
